steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In December 2022, a guest on Equity Mates described Acast as the world's biggest independent podcast company, running a marketplace that hosted around 88,000 podcast series and processed about 1.3 billion listens in Q3, aligning its earnings with creators' monetisation.

episode.title: The world's only listed pure-play podcast company  | Emily Villatte - CFO of Acast

views.text: In July 2021, Equity Mates explained that Acast operated a worldwide podcast hosting and distribution marketplace connecting creators and advertisers, sitting behind apps like Apple Podcasts and Spotify to deliver shows to listeners.

episode.title: Watchlist: Mastermind episode with Julia Lee

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In December 2022, a guest on Equity Mates said Acast held between 50 and 70 percent of top charts in Sweden and the UK and the majority of ad dollars there, and reached 22 million monthly US listeners, highlighting scale advantages.

episode.title: The world's only listed pure-play podcast company  | Emily Villatte - CFO of Acast

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In December 2022, a guest on Equity Mates said Acast bought Podchaser in August to strengthen discoverability with data on listener behaviour and preferences, signalling continued product investment to improve its platform.

episode.title: The world's only listed pure-play podcast company  | Emily Villatte - CFO of Acast
